title: WHEN THE ROAD AHEAD
FEELS UNCERTAIN
end: The Guided Path — seek God's wisdom for every step
stock_queries: calm mountain lake glowing at sunrise
peaceful valley river early light fog
quiet mountain pass illuminated by sun light

scenes.a: If you are stepping into a strange room today without knowing how to proceed, pause.
And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known:
I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
Lord, when the road before us feels obscured, guide our steps into Your truth.
Reveal the light where shadows linger, and smooth every rough path. Give us discernment to follow Your leading, trusting that You will never abandon us.
Subscribe to join us in seeking His wisdom daily.
